name: WireGuard Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free self-managed encrypted VPN tunnels using open-source WireGuard kernel and userspace implementations; no software subscription, seat or tunnel license quota.
watch_out: Not a hosted VPN or automatic device-management service. Requires your own endpoints, key rotation, networking and infrastructure; Linux kernel components use GPLv2 while other platform components have different open-source licenses.
